summary.name: Yeti Switch
summary.one_liner: Yeti Switch is an open-source SIP Session Border Controller, softswitch and real-time VoIP billing system for carrier interconnection.
use_cases: running a prepaid or postpaid VoIP service
routing SIP calls with least-cost routing
connecting a VoIP service to Microsoft Teams Direct Routing
providing a customer self-service VoIP portal
summary.what_it_does: Yeti Switch is a SIP session border controller and softswitch built on the SEMS SIP/RTP stack, aimed at interconnection with telecom carriers. It includes built-in real-time VoIP billing for wholesale transit and for prepaid or postpaid retail services. The page lists support for STIR/SHAKEN call authentication and attestation, and says it can operate as a Microsoft Teams Direct Routing SBC. It offers a REST API for automated configuration and provisioning, and a single-page customer portal powered by that API. The listing describes it as having least-cost routing.
notable: Class 4 softswitch with integrated real-time billing and routing engine
caveats: Platform requirements beyond the web customer portal are not stated on the page
Licensed GPL-2.0 per the awesome-selfhosted listing; page itself does not state licence
